question: We need to log into a supplier portal nobody gives us an API for, click through it and pull a table, on a schedule and from a server. Running headless Chrome ourselves keeps breaking. Which service would you use for that, and what else did you look at before picking it?
summary: Test portal extraction and recovery when the login expires. The recorded mentions do not show whether an agent can complete these tasks.

items.title: Test the documented integration
items.finding: Current docs distinguish Browser Sandbox for API/SDK sessions from Interact for CLI/MCP workflows. Use that supported split. The partial provisioning phrase refers to obtaining an initial dashboard key; the reCAPTCHA marker was not exercised. Neither observation demonstrates a failed portal integration.
items.nextStep: Use the documented Node Browser Sandbox API with an authorized fixture portal. Log in, extract a known table, and close the session while saving its profile. Open a new session using the saved profile, verify the next table extraction, then expire portal authentication and check that it is detected rather than reported as empty data.
items.validation: Keep extracted rows, profile/session identifiers and logged-out detection. Record scheduling separately; do not use the legacy hidden browser CLI as the recommended agent path.

sources.note: Browser Sandbox API/SDK, persistent profiles and supported Interact versus legacy CLI distinction.
